summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release, presentation materials, and supplemental factbook for its first-quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing reports a 17.0% year-over-year revenue increase to USD 1,201 million, EBITDA of USD 517 million, and digital revenue growth of 57.7%. It details financial metrics, operating highlights, and segment performance but does not announce any material definitive agreement, merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction. This is a routine earnings release furnished as a foreign private issuer report. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed. What to watch: continued organic execution and digital transformation momentum.
